title: Cube's Craft - Minecart Tweaks
description: A datapack/resource pack expansion for Cube's Craft that enhances minecarts visually.
body:
![Cube's Craft - Minecart Tweaks Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4fc30b56c59e7e14c1297526d82016d15fa77fe2.png)

**THIS REQUIRES CUBE'S CRAFT TO FUNCTION PROPERLY**

Make sure that THIS PACK is ABOVE the base Cube's Craft pack.

**THIS IS A DATAPACK AND A RESOURCE PACK - DOWNLOAD BOTH**

Put the resources zip into your resource packs folder, and the data zip into your world's datapack folder.

This is a small expansion for Cube's Craft focused on enhancing minecarts. Currently, the changes are purely visual, making any minecart with a block in it pixel consistent with a custom model. However, some mechanical changes may be added in the future.

Check out the other expansions [here](https://modrinth.com/collection/4yhJ4w2t)
